types.name: MiningEpochReceipt
docs: Immutable funded-day fact. Version-two winning-term commitments can accrue
into permanent original-term tax pools. Held version-one commitments remain
liabilities and can never be reinterpreted by that payout protocol.

types.name: ProofNode
docs: Exactly 41 Borsh bytes. Anchor's bool decoder rejects any side other than 0/1.
